message:
test(ka-pc r4): the shared test-host guard, as it is (ka-r3 6b9cf79)

- every test host gets e2e_injection_off_arg (--input-injection-mode none --host-power-management off); no viewer
  exists before e2e_wait_injection_off saw THIS launch say both whole lines -- else e2e_injection_setup_failed
  (RESULT: INVALID, exit 2); at the end a host that logged input with injection on makes the run INVALID (rule 4)
- the published 0.2.163 Host is no longer started (an older binary does not know --host-power-management): that
  case is NOT RUN, unverified
- nothing of the guard is copied or varied here. Not run yet: real-host execution waits for Codex SOURCE OK on the
  guard and a free slot (the verifier)
